description: Mode 2: enrich an already-ingested registry by generating criterion_claims from approved mapping configs. This does not reacquire NARA, PRONOM, LOC, or QNL source data.
notes: Use this when mappings are added after source data has already been ingested.
Run with --dry-run first to inspect counts before writing criterion_claims.
Machine-generated claims are written with review_status=unreviewed unless a mapping explicitly says otherwise.
Composite source ratings such as NARA Risk Level remain hazard estimators and are blocked from criterion_claims by mapping validation.
